item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, skies will be mostly cloudy across the region with low temperatures ranging from the lower forties to the upper forties and a slight chance of rain in some areas. Saturday brings mostly cloudy to overcast conditions with widespread rain likely and high temperatures between the low fifties and upper fifties. Saturday night stays cloudy with lows in the mid-thirties and continued rain, mixing with snow late in some spots.
